thread:
morgan: Heads-up — nightly eval for SUMM-compact prompt set spiked: failure rate jumped from ~2.1% -> 12.8% overnight. eval-bot attached diffs. :eyes:

kai: On it — what's the model and commit?

morgan: model=redwood-v3q-quantized@2026-03-19b commit=6f4a2e3 index-run=nightly-3. seed histogram shows a cluster around 0 and 4294967295 (weird wrap). eval-bot output:
```
FAILURES: 124/970
Top error: hallucination (repetition + wrong facts)
Sampler config: temp=0.7 top_p=0.92 top_k=0
rng_seed: None (runtime-generated)
```

jana: rng_seed None means server chooses seed each run — could expose nondet behavior; did we change default seed behavior in 3/18 runtime patch?

kai: I remember a PR about 'preserve_rng_state' going in for quant kernels. @liam can you check the change log?

liam: yep PR #887 toggled preserve_rng_state=true for quant kernels to speed caching. It serializes state across requests to reuse KV cache — possibly reuses same RNG state between batches. (reacts :frowning:)

morgan: that would explain clustering. Can we reproduce locally with explicit seeds? tried `runtest --model redwood-v3q --temp 0.7 --top_p 0.92 --runs 1000` and saw same failure pattern when i set `--seed=random` vs `--seed=deterministic`.

kai: paste the command you ran and sample outputs.

morgan: `runtest --model redwood-v3q-quant --promptset SUMM-compact --runs 200 --temp 0.7 --top_p 0.92 --seed auto` -> many repeats. With `--seed 42` -> stable behavior, failure rate ~2.4%.

jana: hypothesize: preserve_rng_state causes RNG to be carried across requests in production; when batch boundary aligns with some patterns, effective temp/top_p distribution shifts. Need quick AB: rollout to flip preserve_rng_state off for dedicated nightly traffic.

eval-bot: Canary created: canary/1951234567-preserve-rng-off -> routed 5% traffic to model variant with preserve_rng_state=false

liam: Also check quantized kernel changes: we introduced XOR-based seeding to mix low entropy on quant path. PR #902. If seed mixing uses 32-bit overflow, that could create wrap to 0/4294967295. I'll bisect.

kai: For triage let's run small matrix: seeds=[None,42,12345], temp=[0.5,0.7,1.0], top_p=[0.8,0.92,0.99] with quant vs fp. `./scripts/eval_matrix.sh redwood-v3q-quant SUMM-compact seeds temp top_p --out /tmp/matrix.json`

morgan: started matrix, ETA ~18m. logging here: https://internal/redwood/evals/1951234567

jana: action items: 1) liam bisect PRs #887/#902 2) kai create canary and flip preserve_rng_state for nightly 3) morgan collect sample traces + kv-cache metrics 4) if reproduced, add seeded mode to nightly to reduce flakiness

kai: noted. I'll update the incident doc and ping security if RNG changes could affect cryptographic components (unlikely, but check). :thumbsup: 

morgan: thanks. keep thread updates short. will post matrix results and a 10-sample diff when ready.

eval-bot: Matrix run complete: seed=None shows bimodal entropy; seed=42 stable. Attached small diffs. (reacts :white_check_mark:)

liam: bisect points to PR #887 margin — revert on canary shows failure rate drop to baseline. Will open rollback PR and contact deploy.

morgan: great — moving to rollback. tagging @oncall-eng-ml

oncall-eng-ml: acknowledging, will coordinate rollback window 30m.

morgan: rollback started at 1951234720

oncall-eng-ml: rollback complete at 1951234748 — nightly metrics returning to baseline.

morgan: confirmed final: failure rate 2.3%. closing. Thanks everyone. (reacts :tada:)
